C_COMPILER_CONTEXT.statement: The specified compiler evaluator satisfies Lemma lem:compiler on all presentation words under its exact bounded totality and contextual hypotheses.

C_COMPILER_VALIDATOR.statement: From an arbitrary entry, the validator reaches q_start exactly for the full, entirely clean entry language stated in eq:compiler-clean-entry; its validator predecessors are unique.

C_COMPILER_SIMULATION.statement: The expanded scan program realizes the supplied deterministic machine on every passing entry, and every halting length-nonincreasing computation succeeds with some finite workspace quota.

C_COMPILER_COMPONENTS.statement: Every internal weak component has at most one entry and at most one terminal q_ok sector; if both exist, the entry reaches that terminal genuinely.

C_COMPILER_RUN_ALGEBRA.statement: For every alphabet, arbitrary barrier set, budget m and length-nonincreasing contextual map f through m, raw-run normalization fixes singletons and is invariant under every bounded contextual adjacent-raw contraction.

C_COMPILER_WORD_BRIDGE.statement: On arbitrary quiver paths, every contextual compiler equation gives identical entry-priority preprocessing except the successful-exit case, which gives one bounded adjacent-raw contraction; all preprocessing derivations stay within the original grade.

C_COMPILER_PRIMITIVE_PREPROCESS.statement: For arbitrary tags, cell contexts, and optional boundaries, primitive raw/quota/cleanup preprocessing preserves all raw-slide, quota, merge, and cleanup equations and never raises grade. Internal machine equations and successful exit are excluded.

C_COMPILER_EXIT_BRIDGE.statement: For every internal component of the actually compiled scan machine, q_ok omega = Z omega gives either identical preprocessing or exactly one bounded adjacent-raw contraction, including arbitrary raw neighbors.

C_COMPILER_EXECUTION_THEOREMS.statement: The explicit validator, arbitrary-list scans, copy/output array loops, arbitrary-table bounded pipelines, entry-component criterion and original-word contextual transport satisfy their universally quantified formal specifications. The full literal compiler's source-specific instantiation is a separate ordinary proof.
